title: High-throughput generation of midbrain dopaminergic neuron organoids from reporter human pluripotent stem cells
protocol: Coat the desired number of 10-cm dishes with 8 mL Geltrex solution and store in a CO2 incubator at 37°C for at least 1 h.
Aspirate StemFlex medium from 70%-80% confluent hPSCs in a 10-cm dish.
Wash cells with 8 mL PBS to remove debris.
Aspirate PBS and incubate cells with 3 mL fresh Accutase at 20°C-25°C for 5 min with occasional manual shaking.
Prepare 10 mL wash buffer in a 15-mL conical tube.
Gently pipette cells on the dish 3–5 times using a 5-mL pipette and transfer to the 15-mL tube.
Mix the cells 3–5 times in the 15-mL tube.
Take a small amount of cells for cell count.
Count cells using Trypan Blue solution, Chamber Slides, and a Cell Counter.
Distribute appropriate volume of mixture containing 2 million cells to a new 15-mL tube.
Collect an additional tube with 2 million cells for nucleofection control.
Centrifuge cells at 300 × g for 3 min.
Combine 5 μg TH-TdTomato vector, 1 μg CRISPR 1, and 1 μg CRISPR 2 in a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 100 μl nucleofection mix to the DNA mixture.
For nucleofection control, combine 5 μg pmaxGFP vector with 100 μl nucleofection mix.
Aspirate supernatant from the 15-mL tube.
Gently resuspend cell pellet in nucleofection mix + DNA using a 200-μl pipette tip.
Pipette the cells once gently and transfer to a cuvette provided by the nucleofection kit.
Place cuvettes on ice.
Nucleofect using Program Ca137 on a 4D-Nucleofector Core Unit.
Place cuvettes back on ice.
Remove Geltrex solution from 10-cm dishes and replace with 8 mL/dish StemFlex medium + 2 μM Thiazovivin (pre-warmed to 37°C).
Gently remove the cells from the cuvette using a pipet provided by the nucleofection kit and transfer to the prepared dishes.
Store the plates in the incubator.
On day 1 post-nucleofection observe all plates under a TC microscope to ensure that the cells look healthy and that the nucleofection control group is expressing GFP.
Begin selection with 1 μg/mL puromycin for 48 h to select for transgene integration on day 2 post-nucleofection.
Supplement StemFlex medium with puromycin and change media daily starting from day 2.
Replace media with fresh StemFlex medium without puromycin on day 4 post-nucleofection.
Change media every other day until hPSC colonies are clearly visible by eye (5–7 days).
Pool all colonies together using Accutase and additional trituration with a 1-mL pipet tip to break down chunks of cells.
Use half of the cell suspension for Cre-GFP targeting.
Freeze the other half into 2 or more cryovials as backup before Cre-GFP nucleofection.
Repeat the nucleofection process using 5 μg Cre-GFP vector to remove the puromycin selection cassette.
Include a non-nucleofected negative control and a GFP nucleofection control for fluorescence gating during FACS.
Passage hPSCs to a 6-well plate at 70%–80% confluency in StemFlex medium + 2 μM Thiazovivin 1 hour prior to transfection.
Prepare 1 mL Opti-MEM.
Add 4 μl Lipofectamine to the Opti-MEM tube.
Prepare another tube with 1 mL Opti-MEM.
Add 4 μg targeting vector and 1 μg CRISPR 1 to the second tube.
Add 1 μg CRISPR 2 to the second tube.
Combine contents of both tubes and incubate at 20°C–25°C for 10 minutes.
Replace StemFlex medium with the transfection mix in each well.
Place the plate in the incubator for 2 hours.
Change media to fresh StemFlex medium.
Prepare cells for FACS on day 1 post-nucleofection.
Perform FACS and plate 5,000 – 10,000 GFP+ cells per 10-cm Geltrex-coated dish containing 8 mL StemFlex stock pre-warmed to 37°C.
On day 3 post-nucleofection, replace media with fresh StemFlex medium without Thiazovivin and Pen/Strep.
Change media every other day until hPSC colonies are clearly visible by eye (7–10 days).
Pick colonies more easily when they reach a diameter of at least 1–2 mm.
Remove any debris by changing media to StemFlex stock on the day of colony picking.
Prepare desired number of uncoated 12-well plates with 0.5 mL/well StemFlex stock.
Coat the same number of 12-well plates with Geltrex solution.
Remove Geltrex solution right before plating the colonies.
Pick colonies under sterile TC conditions, tritrate well, and plate one colony per well of a Geltrex-coated 12-well plate in StemFlex stock.
Set up a sterile microscope in a TC hood for colony picking.
Clean the microscope thoroughly with 70% ethanol if not available in a TC hood.
Pick colonies one at a time under the microscope using a 200 μl pipet tip set to 200 μl volume.
Transfer picked colonies to an uncoated 12-well plate.
Triturate each colony further with a separate 1 ml pipet tip and transfer to a Geltrex-coated plate one at a time.
Collect cells from each colony in PCR strips for gDNA extraction using a cell suspension volume of 100–200 μl.
Centrifuge collected cells at 300 × g for 3 min.
Resuspend the pellets in lysis buffer and mix with DirectPCR Lysis Reagent + Proteinase K (1 ml + 25 μl).
Add cell pellets to the mixture resuspension depending on pellet size (40–60 μl).
Follow manufacturer’s guidelines for subsequent steps after mixing.
Analyze transgene integration in collected gDNA samples using touchdown PCR.
Use three reactions (5′, 3′, and 5′3′) to genotype and confirm knock-in clones.
Validate positive colonies identified by PCR using Sanger sequencing.
Prepare frozen stocks from selected colonies.
Further validate knock-in hPSC lines by karyotyping.
Use a different pipet tip to aspirate the medium from each well during media change.
Freeze cells at this stage as post-Cre targeted hPSCs.
Sequencing includes checking 5′3′ PCR product of untargeted allele for CRISPR-mediated changes.
Passage hPSC lines to four 10-cm dishes for seeding into spinner flasks.
Seed approximately 40 × 10^6 cells per flask from four 10-cm dishes at near confluency.
Prepare 120 mL/flask StemFlex stock for seeding hPSCs.
Add 115 mL of StemFlex stock to spinner flasks through the side arms.
Place the spinner flasks on a nine-position stir plate set to 65 rpm in the incubator.
Ensure that the top screw is tightly closed while loosening the two side screws for air exchange.
Aspirate StemFlex medium from the four dishes and wash with 8 mL/dish PBS.
Incubate cells with 3 mL/dish fresh Accutase at 20°C–25°C for 5 min with occasional manual shaking.
Centrifuge cells at 300 × g for 3 min.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL StemFlex stock using a 1-mL pipet tip.
Add 4 mL StemFlex stock to the cells and mix thoroughly.
Filter cells through a 35 μm cell strainer.
Add the cells to the flask from one of the side arms and place back in the incubator.
Monitor spheres daily for formation of small spheres visible by eye within 24 h after seeding.
Allow pluripotent spheres to settle by gravity, then aspirate half the media (60 mL) from one of the side arms.
Replace with fresh StemFlex medium + 10 μM Y-27632.
If large clumps are observed, remove them by filtering spheres through a 500 μm strainer into a 50-mL tube.
Gently return the spheres to the flask.
Allow the pluripotent spheres to settle by gravity on Day -1.
Replace half the media with fresh StemFlex medium without Y-27632.
Filter the pluripotent spheres through a 300 μm strainer into a 50-mL tube on Day 0.
Begin differentiation by complete media change (120 mL) to D0-1 patterning medium.
Change half the media with D0-1 patterning medium on Day 1.
Change half the media with D2-3 patterning medium on Day 2.
Change half the media with D2-3 patterning medium on Day 3.
Change half the media with D4-7 patterning medium on Day 4.
Change half the media on Day 5 with D4-7 patterning medium.
Change half the media on Day 6 with D4-7 patterning medium.
Change half the media on Day 7 with D4-7 patterning medium.
Change most of the media (80 mL) on Day 8 with D8-11 patterning medium.
Change half the media on Day 9 with D8-11 patterning medium.
Change half the media on Day 10 with D8-11 patterning medium.
Change half the media on Day 11 with D8-11 patterning medium.
Change most of the media (80 mL) on Day 12 with D12-21 terminal medium.
Wash organoids in 5 mL PBS in a well of a 6-well plate.
Incubate organoids in 5 mL/well papain solution on a shaker placed in the incubator for 20–30 min.
Gently triturate the organoids with fire-polished Pasteur pipets of decreasing tip sizes attached to dropper bulbs.
Filter the mixture through a 70 μm mesh into a 50-mL tube containing 10 mL incubation medium.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend the pellet in desired amount of FACS buffer or differentiation medium.
Express the TH reporter starting on D15 in TH-TdTomato line for QC.
Plate organoids on PLO/laminin-coated plates starting on D15 for axonal outgrowths.
Observe axonal morphology and TH expression in 2D DN axons using "organoid splatting" method.
Monitor TH expression and neuronal markers such as TUBB3 by IF staining in fixed organoid cryosections.
Quantify TH+ cells in a monolayer culture of dissociated neurons using Fiji and CellProfiler software for neurons stained with antibodies against TH and RFP.
Switch to D36+ terminal medium on Day 36.
Monitor organoids for a diameter of approximately 1 mm.
Change media once every 3–4 days if color is not yellow orange and organoids are not crowded.
Perform QC experiments on mature DN markers including NURR1, GIRK2, PITX3, DAT1, VMAT2, DDC, and TH to confirm identity.
Remove DAPT from the medium since it inhibits astrocyte proliferation and may influence phenotypes associated with mature dopaminergic neurons.
Remove dcAMP from D36+ terminal medium as it has a neuroprotective effect on midbrain dopaminergic neurons.
Observe an increase in TH expression over time if using a TH-TdTomato line.
Dissociate the midbrain organoids and analyze by flow cytometry or sort for downstream applications such as plating on astrocytes or bulk transcriptomics.
